title: 第38章 老丈人的心里话
content_zh:
第38章 老丈人的心里话-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

下一章

王桂兰从灶房探出头来，笑着喊：“吃饭了！都别聊了，上桌！”

饭桌上，气氛比往年好了不知道多少倍。

以前过年回门，林国强总是坐在角落里，没人跟他说话，也没人给他夹菜。

两个姐夫聊他们的，大姐二姐聊她们的，他像个透明人一样坐在那里，吃完就走。

今年不一样了。

刘胜利主动给他倒酒：“国强，来，喝一个。”

“姐夫，我不太会喝。”

“少来！大过年的，喝一个！”刘胜利不由分说地给他满上了。

孙建民也举起了杯子：“国强，我也敬你一个。

志军在你那儿干了这段时间，跟换了个人似的。

以前在家啥也不干，现在知道挣钱了，前两天回来还给岳母了十块钱。

岳母高兴得哭了半宿，这份情，我记着。”

林国强端起杯子，跟他碰了一下：“姐夫客气了，志军本来就不坏，就是以前没人带。

他自己肯干，我只是搭了把手。”

赵志军坐在旁边，听见这话，耳朵红了，低下头使劲扒饭。

王桂兰在旁边给林静和赵素梅夹菜，一边夹一边说：“多吃点！”

赵素梅看着碗里堆成小山的菜，心里有一种说不出的感觉。

往年回娘家，她总是提心吊胆的。

怕两个姐夫瞧不起林国强，怕爹妈脸上无光，怕别人问“你们家今年咋样”的时候不知道怎么回答。

今年不用怕了。

今年，她的男人坐在这张桌子上，跟两个姐夫平起平坐，甚至被他们高看一眼。

她偷偷地看了林国强一眼。

他正在跟刘胜利碰杯，脸上带着笑，不卑不亢，从容得很。

吃完饭，王桂兰拉着几个女儿到灶房说话，在里面嘀嘀咕咕的，不时传出一阵笑声。

赵德厚把林国强叫到堂屋，从柜子里拿出一包东西，塞到他手里。

“国强，这是你妈自己做的腊肉和香肠，带回去吃。”

“爸，您留着吧……”

“拿着。”赵德厚的语气不容拒绝，“你在镇上开店，忙，没时间做这些。

你妈做得多，够吃。”

林国强接过来，沉甸甸的，大概有十来斤。

“谢谢爸。”

赵德厚摆了摆手，沉默了一会儿，忽然说：“国强，我跟你说句心里话。”

“爸，您说。”

Chapter 38 My father-in-law’s inner thoughts - "Reborn in 80, taking my wife and daughter to eat and drink after the separation"

Wang Guilan poked her head out of the kitchen and shouted with a smile: "It's time to eat! Stop talking and serve!"

At the dinner table, the atmosphere was infinitely better than in previous years.

In the past, when returning home for the New Year, Lin Guoqiang would always sit in the corner, with no one talking to him or picking up food for him.

The two brothers-in-law talked about theirs, and the elder sister and the second sister talked about theirs. He sat there like a transparent person and left after eating.

This year is different.

Liu Shengli took the initiative to pour him a drink: "Guoqiang, come on, have a drink."

"Brother-in-law, I'm not very good at drinking."

"Come on! If you're celebrating the Chinese New Year, have a drink!" Liu Shengli filled it up for him without any explanation.

Sun Jianmin also raised his cup: "Guoqiang, I also respect you.

Zhijun has been working at your place for this period of time, as if he was a different person.

I used to do nothing at home, but now I know how to make money. I returned ten yuan to my mother-in-law two days ago.

My mother-in-law was so happy that she cried for half the night. I will remember this feeling."

Lin Guoqiang picked up the cup and clinked it with him: "Brother-in-law, you're welcome, Zhijun is not bad in the first place, it's just that no one took him with him before.

He was willing to do it himself, I just helped him."

Zhao Zhijun was sitting next to him. When he heard this, his ears turned red and he lowered his head to pick up the rice.

Wang Guilan was picking up vegetables for Lin Jing and Zhao Sumei. While doing so, she said, "Eat more!"

Zhao Sumei looked at the mountains of vegetables in the bowl and felt an indescribable feeling in her heart.

In previous years, she was always nervous when she returned to her parents' home.

I'm afraid that my two brothers-in-law will look down on Lin Guoqiang, that my parents will be disgraced, and that they won't know how to answer when people ask, "How is your family this year?"

Don’t be afraid this year.

This year, her man sat at this table, on an equal footing with his two brothers-in-law, and was even looked down upon by them.

She glanced at Lin Guoqiang secretly.

He was clinking glasses with Liu Shengli, with a smile on his face, neither humble nor overbearing, and very calm.

After dinner, Wang Guilan took her daughters to the kitchen to talk. They were mumbling and laughing from time to time.

Zhao Dehou called Lin Guoqiang to the main room, took out a package of things from the cabinet and stuffed it into his hand.

"Guoqiang, these are the bacon and sausages your mother made. Take them home to eat."

"Dad, please keep it..."

"Take it." Zhao Dehou's tone refused, "You are busy opening a store in the town and don't have time to do this.

Your mother cooks more, enough to eat."

Lin Guoqiang took it. It was heavy, weighing about ten kilograms.

"Thanks dad."

Zhao Dehou waved his hand, was silent for a while, and then suddenly said: "Guoqiang, let me tell you something from my heart."

"Dad, tell me."
